verdict.rationale: AgentMail's docs name an official Python SDK, state that all its SDKs are open source under MIT, and show a JS/TS-style client call on the homepage. A community user also praised the dashboard's SDK example popovers. Missing for 10: an explicit documented list of supported SDK languages with install/package details, and hands-on independent reports of building against the SDKs beyond the UI examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use our Python SDK for seamless integration with your Python applications.
All of our SDKs are open source and available under the MIT license.
popovers showing SDK examples were called "a brilliant UI idea (executed with great polish)."
